claims.supported_claim: SafeHandle packs reference count/Closed/Disposed; AddRef rejects Closed rather than treating Disposed as an independent admission gate; physical release occurs after the last reference.
limitations: Does not itself establish NativeWeave logical admission, async retention, native callback quiescence or parent/module lifetime.

claims.supported_claim: YAHA child handles retain parent SafeHandles; native destroy and matching parent release form a concrete ownership chain; context owns TLS verifier GCHandle.
